title: China’s Only Female Emperor: Wu Zetian
synopsis: How did China’s only female emperor rise to power?

fullText.simplified:
一代女皇武则天

    在中国的历史上，共出现过四百多位皇帝。在男尊女卑的古代社会，皇帝毫无疑问都是由男人担任。可就在那男权极盛的封建社会中，横空出现了一位绝无仅有的女皇帝。她便是传奇女皇“武则天”。
   “武则天”并不是其本名。它来源于武则天的封号“则天大圣皇帝”，这是武则天做过皇帝的印记。武则天十四岁入宫。初入宫时被唐太宗李世民封为“才人”，所以那时候武则天多被称为“武才人”。
    据说唐太宗在位时有一则预言。预言说“帝传三世，武代李兴”，意思是大唐的皇帝传了三代后，会被姓“武”的人夺走江山。所以唐太宗一直忌惮着武则天，没太宠幸她。直至唐太宗驾崩，武则天还是一名地位低下的才人，她没有怀上皇帝的孩子。然而在唐太宗病重的时候，武则天和唐太宗的儿子李治渐渐有了感情。唐太宗驾崩后，根据当时的律例，她因没有孩子，不得不与其他没有孩子的嫔妃一起前往感业寺出家为尼。就这样，她和李治不得不分开了。
    一年后，李治去感业寺祭拜唐太宗时，重遇了武则天。此时李治已是皇帝。他力排众议，不顾流言蜚语让武则天回到了宫中。回宫后封其为“武昭仪”，比“武才人”上升了好几个等级。可是武则天已经不满足于仅仅是个昭仪了，她有了更大的野心。
    相传她亲手掐死了自己才几个月大的女儿，并嫁祸给了当时的王皇后。就这样，王皇后被废，武则天成了新皇后。
    李治晚年的时候经常头晕，于是将很多政务交予武则天代劳。武则天也逐渐参与到朝政上来。她的智慧和才能让她将政务处理得井井有条，她也浅尝到了权利的滋味。在李治晚年，武则天和李治合称为“二圣”，两人一起上朝。
    但武则天的野心远不止于此。传闻，她一共有四个儿子，其中两位有继承皇位资格的儿子被其杀害。中国有句古话叫“虎毒不食子”，可是这句话并不适用于帝王家，尤其不适用于像武则天这样对权力和欲望极其渴望的人。武则天的女皇宝座滴着自己亲生骨肉的血。
    李治去世后，六十七岁的武则天称帝，改国号为“周”。从李治晚年她帮忙处理政务到她自己当上女皇，武则天掌权的五十年，干了不少有利于国家和人民的好事。
    武则天在位期间，致力于选拔优秀的人才，她让大批有才能的穷人们得到了重用的机会。她也像唐太宗那样擅于听取别人的意见，甚至还设立了专门的“意见箱”来吸纳宝贵的建议。在经济上，武则天大力发展水利，减轻农民的赋税。在她执政期间，人民生活安逸，社会稳定。
    然而武则天到了晚年，变得昏庸起来。她听信自己娘家人和“男妃”们的话，滥杀了许多无辜的人。
    武则天死前让人为其在墓前立一块“无字碑”。碑上空空如也，没有任何文字。后世之人猜不透这无字碑的含义。有的人觉得武则天是在夸耀自己的功绩大到无法用文字来形容，有的人觉得武则天是不想评价自己的功与过。她立下“无字碑”，一生功过让后人去评说！
fullText.traditional:
一代女皇武則天

    在中國的歷史上，共出現過四百多位皇帝。在男尊女卑的古代社會，皇帝毫無疑問都是由男人擔任。可就在那男權極盛的封建社會中，橫空出現了一位絕無僅有的女皇帝。她便是傳奇女皇“武則天”。
   “武則天”並不是其本名。它來源於武則天的封號“則天大聖皇帝”，這是武則天做過皇帝的印記。武則天十四歲入宮。初入宮時被唐太宗李世民封為“才人”，所以那時候武則天多被稱為“武才人”。
    據說唐太宗在位時有一則預言。預言說“帝傳三世，武代李興”，意思是大唐的皇帝傳了三代後，會被姓“武”的人奪走江山。所以唐太宗一直忌憚著武則天，沒太寵幸她。直至唐太宗駕崩，武則天還是一名地位低下的才人，她沒有懷上皇帝的孩子。然而在唐太宗病重的時候，武則天和唐太宗的兒子李治漸漸有了感情。唐太宗駕崩後，根據當時的律例，她因沒有孩子，不得不與其他沒有孩子的嬪妃一起前往感業寺出家為尼。就這樣，她和李治不得不分開了。
    一年後，李治去感業寺祭拜唐太宗時，重遇了武則天。此時李治已是皇帝。他力排眾議，不顧流言蜚語讓武則天回到了宮中。回宮後封其為“武昭儀”，比“武才人”上昇了好幾個等級。可是武則天已經不滿足於僅僅是個昭儀了，她有了更大的野心。
    相傳她親手掐死了自己才幾個月大的女兒，並嫁禍給了當時的王皇后。就這樣，王皇后被廢，武則天成了新皇后。
    李治晚年的時候經常頭暈，於是將很多政務交予武則天代勞。武則天也逐漸參與到朝政上來。她的智慧和才能讓她將政務處理得井井有條，她也淺嘗到了權利的滋味。在李治晚年，武則天和李治合稱為“二聖”，兩人一起上朝。
    但武則天的野心遠不止於此。傳聞，她一共有四個兒子，其中兩位有繼承皇位資格的兒子被其殺害。中國有句古話叫“虎毒不食子”，可是這句話並不適用於帝王家，尤其不適用於像武則天這樣對權力和慾望極其渴望的人。武則天的女皇寶座滴著自己親生骨肉的血。
    李治去世後，六十七歲的武則天稱帝，改國號為“周”。從李治晚年她幫忙處理政務到她自己當上女皇，武則天掌權的五十年，幹了不少有利於國家和人民的好事。
    武則天在位期間，致力於選拔優秀的人才，她讓大批有才能的窮人們得到了重用的機會。她也像唐太宗那樣擅於聽取別人的意見，甚至還設立了專門的“意見箱”來吸納寶貴的建議。在經濟上，武則天大力發展水利，減輕農民的賦稅。在她執政期間，人民生活安逸，社會穩定。
    然而武則天到了晚年，變得昏庸起來。她聽信自己娘家人和“男妃”們的話，濫殺了許多無辜的人。
    武則天死前讓人為其在墓前立一塊“無字碑”。碑上空空如也，沒有任何文字。後世之人猜不透這無字碑的含義。有的人覺得武則天是在誇耀自己的功績大到無法用文字來形容，有的人覺得武則天是不想評價自己的功與過。她立下“無字碑”，一生功過讓後人去評說！

sentences.pinyin: yú shì jiāng hěn duō zhèng wù jiāo yǔ wǔ zé tiān dài láo
sentences.english: In his later years, Li Zhi often felt dizzy, ..

sentences.simplified: 武则天也逐渐参与到朝政上来。
sentences.traditional: 武則天也逐漸參與到朝政上來。
sentences.pinyin: wǔ zé tiān yě zhú jiàn cān yù dào cháo zhèng shàng lái
sentences.english: .. so he handed over a lot of government affairs to Wu Zetian to take care of in his place.

sentences.simplified: 她的智慧和才能让她将政务处理得井井有条，
sentences.traditional: 她的智慧和才能讓她將政務處理得井井有條，
sentences.pinyin: tā de zhì huì hé cái néng ràng tā jiāng zhèng wù chǔ lǐ de jǐng jǐng yǒu tiáo
sentences.english: Wu Zetian also gradually began participating in the politics of the royal court.

sentences.simplified: 她也浅尝到了权利的滋味。
sentences.traditional: 她也淺嘗到了權利的滋味。
sentences.pinyin: tā yě qiǎn cháng dào le quán lì de zī wèi
sentences.english: Her intelligence and talent allowed her to handle government affairs in perfect order, ..

sentences.simplified: 在李治晚年，武则天和李治合称为“二圣”，
sentences.traditional: 在李治晚年，武則天和李治合稱為“二聖”，
sentences.pinyin: zài lǐ zhì wǎn nián wǔ zé tiān hé lǐ zhì hé chēng wéi èr shèng
sentences.english: .. and she began to get a taste for power.

sentences.simplified: 两人一起上朝。
sentences.traditional: 兩人一起上朝。
sentences.pinyin: liǎng rén yì qǐ shǎng cháo
sentences.english: In Li Zhi’s later years, Wu Zetian and Li Zhi were collectively referred to as “The Two Saints”.
The two attended imperial court together.

sentences.simplified: 但武则天的野心远不止于此。
sentences.traditional: 但武則天的野心遠不止於此。
sentences.pinyin: dàn wǔ zé tiān de yě xīn yuǎn bù zhǐ yú cǐ

sentences.simplified: 传闻，她一共有四个儿子，
sentences.traditional: 傳聞，她一共有四個兒子，
sentences.pinyin: chuán wén tā yí gòng yǒu sì ge ér zi
sentences.english: But, Wu Zetian’s ambition was far from stopping there.

sentences.simplified: 其中两位有继承皇位资格的儿子被其杀害。
sentences.traditional: 其中兩位有繼承皇位資格的兒子被其殺害。
sentences.pinyin: qí zhōng liǎng wèi yǒu jì chéng huáng wèi zī gé de ér zi bèi qí shā hài
sentences.english: It is rumored that she had a total of four sons.

sentences.simplified: 中国有句古话叫“虎毒不食子”，
sentences.traditional: 中國有句古話叫“虎毒不食子”，
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó yǒu jù gǔ huà jiào hǔ dú bù shí zǐ
sentences.english: Of her four sons, the two that were eligible to inherit the throne were murdered by her.

sentences.simplified: 可是这句话并不适用于帝王家，
sentences.traditional: 可是這句話並不適用於帝王家，
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zhè jù huà bìng bú shì yòng yú dì wáng jiā
sentences.english: In China there is an ancient saying, “Even a vicious tiger will not eat its cubs”.

sentences.simplified: 尤其不适用于像武则天这样对权力和欲望极其渴望的人。
sentences.traditional: 尤其不適用於像武則天這樣對權力和慾望極其渴望的人。
sentences.pinyin: yóu qí bú shì yòng yú xiàng wǔ zé tiān zhè yàng duì quán lì hé yù wàng jí qí kě wàng de rén
sentences.english: However, this saying does not apply to royal families.

sentences.simplified: 武则天的女皇宝座滴着自己亲生骨肉的血。
sentences.traditional: 武則天的女皇寶座滴著自己親生骨肉的血。
sentences.pinyin: wǔ zé tiān de nǚ huáng bǎo zuò dī zhe zì jǐ qīn shēng gǔ ròu de xiě
sentences.english: And it especially not apply to someone who was as hungry for power and passion as Wu Zetian.
Wu Zetian’s imperial throne dripped with the blood of her children, her own flesh and blood.

sentences.simplified: 李治去世后，六十七岁的武则天称帝，改国号为“周”。
sentences.traditional: 李治去世後，六十七歲的武則天稱帝，改國號為“周”。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ zhì qù shì hòu liù shí qī suì de wǔ zé tiān chēng dì gǎi guó hào wéi zhōu

sentences.simplified: 从李治晚年她帮忙处理政务到她自己当上女皇，
sentences.traditional: 從李治晚年她幫忙處理政務到她自己當上女皇，
sentences.pinyin: cóng lǐ zhì wǎn nián tā bāng máng chǔ lǐ zhèng wù dào tā zì jǐ dāng shang nǚ huáng
sentences.english: After Li Zhi died, the sixty-seven year old Wu Zetian declared herself emperor and changed the dynastic name to “Zhou”.

sentences.simplified: 武则天掌权的五十年，干了不少有利于国家和人民的好事。
sentences.traditional: 武則天掌權的五十年，幹了不少有利於國家和人民的好事。
sentences.pinyin: wǔ zé tiān zhǎng quán de wǔ shí nián gàn le bù shǎo yǒu lì yú guó jiā hé rén mín de hǎo shì
sentences.english: From helping with government affairs in Li Zhi’s later years to becoming emperor herself, ..
.. during her fifty years in power Wu Zetian did many things that benefited the country and its people.

sentences.simplified: 武则天在位期间，致力于选拔优秀的人才，
sentences.traditional: 武則天在位期間，致力於選拔優秀的人才，
sentences.pinyin: wǔ zé tiān zài wèi qī jiān zhì lì yú xuǎn bá yōu xiù de rén cái

sentences.simplified: 她让大批有才能的穷人们得到了重用的机会。
sentences.traditional: 她讓大批有才能的窮人們得到了重用的機會。
sentences.pinyin: tā ràng dà pī yǒu cái néng de qióng rén men dé dào le zhòng yòng de jī huì
sentences.english: During her reign, she strove to find outstanding talent.

sentences.simplified: 她也像唐太宗那样擅于听取别人的意见，
sentences.traditional: 她也像唐太宗那樣擅於聽取別人的意見，
sentences.pinyin: tā yě xiàng táng tài zōng nà yàng shàn yú tīng qǔ bié ren de yì jiàn
sentences.english: She gave lots of talented poor people the opportunity to be put in important positions.

sentences.simplified: 甚至还设立了专门的“意见箱”来吸纳宝贵的建议。
sentences.traditional: 甚至還設立了專門的“意見箱”來吸納寶貴的建議。
sentences.pinyin: shèn zhì hái shè lì le zhuān mén de yì jiàn xiāng lái xī nà bǎo guì de jiàn yì
sentences.english: Like Emperor Taizong of Tang, she was also keen on listening to the opinions of others.

sentences.simplified: 在经济上，武则天大力发展水利，减轻农民的赋税。
sentences.traditional: 在經濟上，武則天大力發展水利，減輕農民的賦稅。
sentences.pinyin: zài jīng jì shang wǔ zé tiān dà lì fā zhǎn shuǐ lì jiǎn qīng nóng mín de fù shuì
sentences.english: She even set up a special “suggestion box” to take in valuable suggestions.

sentences.simplified: 在她执政期间，人民生活安逸，社会稳定。
sentences.traditional: 在她執政期間，人民生活安逸，社會穩定。
sentences.pinyin: zài tā zhí zhèng qī jiān rén mín shēng huó ān yì shè huì wěn dìng
sentences.english: In terms of the economy, Wu Zetian vigorously developed irrigation works and alleviated taxation on farmers.
During the time she was in power, the people’s lives were easy and comfortable, and society was stable.

sentences.simplified: 然而武则天到了晚年，变得昏庸起来。
sentences.traditional: 然而武則天到了晚年，變得昏庸起來。
sentences.pinyin: rán ér wǔ zé tiān dào le wǎn nián biàn de hūn yōng qǐ lái

sentences.simplified: 她听信自己娘家人和“男妃”们的话，滥杀了许多无辜的人。
sentences.traditional: 她聽信自己娘家人和“男妃”們的話，濫殺了許多無辜的人。
sentences.pinyin: tā tīng xìn zì jǐ niáng jia rén hé nán fēi men de huà làn shā le xǔ duō wú gū de rén
sentences.english: Yet in Wu Zetian’s later years, she started to become muddleheaded.
She listened to people from her parents’ family and to “male concubines”, and massacred many innocent people.

sentences.simplified: 武则天死前让人为其在墓前立一块“无字碑”。
sentences.traditional: 武則天死前讓人為其在墓前立一塊“無字碑”。
sentences.pinyin: wǔ zé tiān sǐ qián ràng rén wèi qí zài mù qián lì yí kuài wú zì bēi

sentences.simplified: 碑上空空如也，没有任何文字。
sentences.traditional: 碑上空空如也，沒有任何文字。
sentences.pinyin: bēi shang kōng kōng rú yě méi yǒu rèn hé wén zì
sentences.english: Before her death, Wu Zetian asked people to put up a “wordless stele” in front of her mausoleum.

sentences.simplified: 后世之人猜不透这无字碑的含义。
sentences.traditional: 後世之人猜不透這無字碑的含義。
sentences.pinyin: hòu shì zhī rén cāi bú tòu zhè wú zì bēi de hán yì
sentences.english: The stele was completely blank and empty; there were no words.

sentences.simplified: 有的人觉得武则天是在夸耀自己的功绩大到无法用文字来形容，
sentences.traditional: 有的人覺得武則天是在誇耀自己的功績大到無法用文字來形容，
sentences.pinyin: yǒu de rén jué de wǔ zé tiān shì zài kuā yào zì jǐ de gōng jì dà dào wú fǎ yòng wén zì lái xíng róng
sentences.english: People of later generations are unable to figure out the meaning behind this wordless stele.

sentences.simplified: 有的人觉得武则天是不想评价自己的功与过。
sentences.traditional: 有的人覺得武則天是不想評價自己的功與過。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu de rén jué de wǔ zé tiān shì bù xiǎng píng jià zì jǐ de gōng yǔ guò
sentences.english: Some people think Wu Zetian was boasting that her contributions were so great that they couldn’t be put into words.

sentences.simplified: 她立下“无字碑”，一生功过让后人去评说！
sentences.traditional: 她立下“無字碑”，一生功過讓後人去評說！
sentences.pinyin: tā lì xià wú zì bēi yì shēng gōng guò ràng hòu rén qù píng shuō
sentences.english: Others think that Wu Zetian didn’t want to assess her own accomplishments and mistakes.
She erected this “wordless stele”, leaving her lifetime’s accomplishments and mistakes for later generations to evaluate!

raw.synopsis: How did China’s only female emperor rise to power?
sentence_translations: The Empress of the Dynasty: Wu Zetian
In China’s history, there have been more than four hundred emperors.
In ancient society that regarded men as superior to women, ..
.. it was unquestioned that the role of emperor was held by a man.
Yet out of that extremely patriarchal, feudal society, ..
.. there appeared the towering figure of a one-of-its-kind female emperor.
She was the legendary female emperor Wu Zetian.
Wu Zetian was actually not her real name.
The name came from the title granted to Wu Zetian, “Zetian Dasheng Huangdi”.
This was the mark that showed that Wu Zetian had served as emperor.
Wu Zetian entered the palace at age fourteen.
When she first entered the palace, she was deemed by Emperor Taizong of Tang as a “fifth-ranked imperial consort”.
So at that time, Wu Zetian was mostly referred to as “Fifth-ranked Imperial Consort Wu”.
It is said that during Emperor Taizong of Tang’s reign, there was a prophecy.
The prophecy said, “After the title of emperor is passed down three generations, Wu will rise in place of Li.”
Meaning that, after the title of emperor in the Tang Dynasty was passed down three generations, ..
.. state power will be taken away by someone of the surname of Wu.
Because of this, Emperor Taizong of Tang constantly feared Wu Zetian, and didn’t show much special favor to her.
When Emperor Taizong of Tang passed away, Wu Zetian was still an imperial consort of low status.
She wasn’t pregnant with the emperor’s child, either.
Yet when Emperor Taizong of Tang was gravely ill, ..
.. Wu Zetian and Emperor Taizong of Tang’s son, Li Zhi, started to develop feelings.
After Emperor Taizong of Tang passed away, according to the laws of the time, because she did not have children, ..
.. she would have to become a nun at the Ganye Temple with the other imperial concubines who did not have children.
Just like this, she and Li Zhi had no choice but to separate.
A year later, when Li Zhi went to Ganye Temple to pray to Emperor Taizong of Tang, he encountered Wu Zetian once again.
At this time, Li Zhi was already the emperor.
He stood his ground against the views of the masses, ignored rumors and gossip, and let Wu Zetian return to the palace.
After returning to the palace, she became “Second-ranked Imperial Consort Wu”.
Compared to “Fifth-ranked Imperial Consort Wu”, she was promoted several ranks.
However, Wu Zetian was already dissatisfied with merely being a second-ranked imperial consort.
She began to have even greater ambitions.
According to legend, she strangled her daughter who was only a few months old to death with her own hands.
She then put the blame on the empress of the time, Empress Wang.
Just like this, Empress Wang was ousted and Wu Zetian became the new empress.
In his later years, Li Zhi often felt dizzy, ..
.. so he handed over a lot of government affairs to Wu Zetian to take care of in his place.
Wu Zetian also gradually began participating in the politics of the royal court.
Her intelligence and talent allowed her to handle government affairs in perfect order, ..
.. and she began to get a taste for power.
In Li Zhi’s later years, Wu Zetian and Li Zhi were collectively referred to as “The Two Saints”.
The two attended imperial court together.
But, Wu Zetian’s ambition was far from stopping there.
It is rumored that she had a total of four sons.
Of her four sons, the two that were eligible to inherit the throne were murdered by her.
In China there is an ancient saying, “Even a vicious tiger will not eat its cubs”.
However, this saying does not apply to royal families.
And it especially not apply to someone who was as hungry for power and passion as Wu Zetian.
Wu Zetian’s imperial throne dripped with the blood of her children, her own flesh and blood.
After Li Zhi died, the sixty-seven year old Wu Zetian declared herself emperor and changed the dynastic name to “Zhou”.
From helping with government affairs in Li Zhi’s later years to becoming emperor herself, ..
.. during her fifty years in power Wu Zetian did many things that benefited the country and its people.
During her reign, she strove to find outstanding talent.
She gave lots of talented poor people the opportunity to be put in important positions.
Like Emperor Taizong of Tang, she was also keen on listening to the opinions of others.
She even set up a special “suggestion box” to take in valuable suggestions.
In terms of the economy, Wu Zetian vigorously developed irrigation works and alleviated taxation on farmers.
During the time she was in power, the people’s lives were easy and comfortable, and society was stable.
Yet in Wu Zetian’s later years, she started to become muddleheaded.
She listened to people from her parents’ family and to “male concubines”, and massacred many innocent people.
Before her death, Wu Zetian asked people to put up a “wordless stele” in front of her mausoleum.
The stele was completely blank and empty; there were no words.
People of later generations are unable to figure out the meaning behind this wordless stele.
Some people think Wu Zetian was boasting that her contributions were so great that they couldn’t be put into words.
Others think that Wu Zetian didn’t want to assess her own accomplishments and mistakes.
She erected this “wordless stele”, leaving her lifetime’s accomplishments and mistakes for later generations to evaluate!
